Reference 1 is the LOCKED headless mannequin pose atlas: preserve its joint positions, neck/collar opening, shoulder/hip heights, wrist and hand positions, knees, ankles, each lifted foot, exact stride, body proportions and feet baseline FRAME FOR FRAME. Reference 2 is the approved player illustration for organic cloth folds, outlines and soft shading. EXACT layout FOUR columns by FOUR rows, a portrait atlas about 1152x1728 (2:3); rows FRONT/down, RIGHT PROFILE, BACK/up, LEFT PROFILE; columns the corresponding FOUR distinct approved walk poses. Keep the large transparent upper headroom and each body in the LOWER half of its cell, at the exact source scale and location. NECK DOWN ONLY: no head, hair, face, ears, hat, bust portraits or extra characters. True transparent alpha, no ground, no shadows, no text, no grid, separate cells with generous transparent gutters. Keep the source average-build young-adult body with short friendly proportions. All exposed skin is warm tan #cf9670, natural connected individual hands and toes. No 3D, vector-flat shapes, stiff stick figures or warped anatomy. No pose reinterpretation, no added limb, no torso resizing, no direction changes within a row. Original expressive hand-illustrated indie-RPG finish: tailored moving cloth, organic folds, warm dark outlines, restrained value shading. Important material keys: top fabric medium blue #5086bf, bottoms dark navy #36405a, shoe leather brown #2b1d14; shade each fabric only with VALUE changes in its own key hue. Preserve cream/white details and small brass buttons. Reproduce the exact body geometry of reference 1 rather than drawing a new body. Dark navy #36405a knee-length soft A-LINE SKIRT, with a clear waistband, lightly pleated natural hem swaying a little behind the stride, no trousers or shorts under the skirt. Show tan #cf9670 bare lower legs in the exact locked knee/ankle poses, not stockings. Companion short fitted key-blue tee tucked in and brown cream-soled SNEAKERS. Keep both legs distinct and physically attached behind the skirt.
POSE REGISTRATION CORRECTION. Keep the EXACT thin mannequin anatomy and placement from reference 1. Earlier result shifted the hands; redraw with smaller fitted garment shapes and preserve precise wrist/hand position. Cells requiring correction: up/0, up/1, up/2, up/3, left/2 (direction/frame indexes start at zero). Match all hands, shoulder openings, ankle positions and heel/toe silhouettes precisely to reference 1 in every cell. No extra body bulk. No redesign or pose reinterpretation. Reference 3 is the previous garment rendering, for clothing design ONLY; anatomy must follow reference 1. Preserve all sixteen poses. Transparent background alpha, no brown or black background paint.
